children: Iron ore prices are lower in early Asian trade, weighed by high supply and weakening steel demand, Citic Futures analysts write in a note. Shipments and arrivals remain elevated and inventories held up at congested ports have edged higher. Freely negotiated terms for long-term contracts with major Australian miners have also softened. While elevated freight rates could provide some support to prices, iron ore is likely to remain rangebound in the near term. Risks to the downside also include a faster decline in hot-metal output or tighter production controls, they say. The most actively traded January iron ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is 0.35% lower at CNY705.5 a ton.(jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
